proposed_widenings.name: ItemDestructionPolicy.on_hit_becomes_nonmagical
proposed_widenings.justification: The unit fits the existing magic-item passive family, but the current destruction/lifecycle surface cannot represent a passive ammunition item whose magical property ends specifically when it hits a target.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Once it hits a target, the ammunition is no longer magical.

notes: Authored as a magic-item collection with +1/+2/+3 passive variants. Dhall compiled, `pnpm typecheck` passed, and the tracer emitted a valid graph. The trace honestly omits the hit-triggered loss-of-magic rider because the current surface has no destruction variant for that lifecycle.
